title: Age levels and the ADM
text:

title: The teams
text:
four teams, each with home and away kits. all the rosters are made up: invented names numbers. 
 aaaa sparkle selects: neon pink, yellow blue.
 b squad: black pink.
 saber cats: electric green.
 icers: navy white.

every team carries 13 skaters 2 goalies. player has ratings for skating, shooting, passing, stickhandling, checking stamina, plus coachability exposure. you can read how those last two work in behind game.
